title: IAM scaffolding generator and least-privilege policy kit (upgrade-safe + smoke tests)
creator: Ava Chen
description: Deliver a Terraform module and CI-integrated toolkit that scaffolds IAM/RBAC resources for Private (VPC) deployments with strong least-privilege defaults, upgrade-safe policy deltas, and automated smoke/health checks. The module should be opinionated but configurable: generate roles, permission boundaries, service account bindings, cross-account role templates, and a lightweight permission-cost estimator to help customers anticipate large policy changes. Include preflight plan-time policy analyzers and post-apply smoke tests for common runtime failures.
acceptance_criteria: Module exposes a documented set of inputs for principal types (instance profile, service account, lambda, cross-account role) and outputs stable role ARNs/IDs
Default generated policies follow least-privilege patterns (deny-all except explicitly allowed actions) and are size-optimized (use conditions and resource scoping)
Upgrade compatibility: applying module with minor version bumps produces a clear 'policy delta' report and non-destructive plan by default
CI preflight step runs 'tf plan' and a policy-analyzer that flags any privilege escalations or broadening of *:Action; failing CI prevents merge
A smoke-test runner (Terraform remote-exec + small test harness) verifies assume-role, token retrieval, and a minimal set of allowed API calls after apply
Comprehensive examples for single-account, cross-account, and delegated-control setups included in examples/ with README
Automated terraform fmt/validate/plan checks and an integration test that runs in the private deployment pipeline
Security review completed and documented in runbook; playbook for emergency rollback included
tasks: Design schema for role templates, permission boundaries, and binding patterns (inputs/outputs)
Implement Terraform module with submodules for role-templates, boundary-generator, and bindings
Add a permission-cost estimator script (Python) that reports policy size and potential IAM limits
Create a policy-diff generator that parses 'tfplan' and outputs human-readable delta and risk score
Implement CI integration: preflight analyzer and post-apply smoke tests
Write README, examples, and an upgrade playbook with rollback steps
Conduct internal security review and iterate on least-privilege defaults
Open GitHub PR and shepherd through code review; address infra/ops feedback

notes: Trade-offs: opinionated defaults reduce customer copy-paste but require strong migration guidance; plan to include an opt-out migration flag
We will not attempt to automatically modify existing customer-managed policies; module will offer a 'migrate' helper and a safe preview mode
Scope: initial release focuses on AWS IAM; subsequent work will add GCP/IAM and Azure AD role mappings
